summary: Specific performance of sham agreement claim; Sections 91-92 Evidence Act not barring evidence of fictitious agreement; second plaintiff admitted agreement was sham deterrent; registered agreement's enforceability despite subsequent sales; bona fides of purchasers questioned; Zamindari Abolition Act restriction on non-agriculturist transfer; specific performance decree analysis; subsequent purchasers' notice via registration; readiness and willingness standard applied; agreement for deterrence not valid consideration; specific performance denied where agreement not intended to be acted upon.
legal_provisions_cited: Uttar Pradesh Civil Laws (Reforms and Amendment) Act, 1976
Section 154-B Uttaranchal (Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950) Amendment Ordinance, 2003
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; specific performance decree set aside; agreement held sham not intended to be acted upon; subsequent sale deeds upheld.
